title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: Head of design

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

They recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We are looking for an exceptional individual to help design, build and scale Nova's next generation of products, working closely with the founders and the greater founding team. We're looking for an outstanding product designer who will:

  • Lead the design of payment experiences for both consumers and merchants, across mobile apps and desktop platforms, from research to polished, shipped product
  • Help shape Nova's product vision and design direction, influencing decisions beyond your own projects.
  • Raise the design quality bar across the product, mentoring others and improving how the whole team ships UI.
  • Operate as an important IC designer, partnering directly with founders and leaders on product vision• Build and evolve design systems ensuring scalable, accessible, and delightful UIs.
  • Prototype and test ideas rapidly, validating hypotheses with real users.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering to align design decisions with business outcomes.
  • Share work frequently in constructive design critiques and contribute to our design culture of openness and iteration.
  • Occasionally support brand and marketing initiatives (landing pages, campaigns) when your craft can raise the bar.

This is your chance to be a key player at work, working on challenging projects with significant impact, as part of a select team of members at an ambitious and unique new payment network company.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years designing digital products with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, including mobile interfaces.
  • Strong visual and interaction design craft with systematic thinking.• Daily use of AI in your design workflow (research, synthesis, spec'ing, prototyping).
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments, balancing high quality with speed.
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Preferred:

  • Experience building and shipping production-quality interfaces with AI coding tools (Replit, Cursor, Claude Code, v0, etc.), reducing or removing the need for front-end handoff.
  • Experience in fintech or payments in Brazil.
  • Background in early-stage startups, especially in 0→1 environments.
  • Familiarity with user research, testing, and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Metabase).

The Target Companies

Candidates with at least 2 years of full-time experience in the companies below will be prioritized:

  • Strong Fintechs: Nubank, Revolut, Wise, Mercado Pago, Brex, Itaú, Cora
  • Strong Local Digital Product Companies: QuintoAndar, iFood, Wildlife, Mercado Livre, Globo
  • Strong Design Consultancies: Work&Co, Metalab, Huge, R/GA, Accenture Song
  • Big Tech: Google, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft
  • Other Tech: Notion, Netflix, Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, Spotify, Snap, X (Twitter), Pinterest

The Selection Process

Materials about Nova, including a pitch deck and pitch videos will be made available through the process

Portfolio Review: Async review of your portfolio by the design team to assess craft, depth of thinking, and end-to-end product work. Portfolio is required.

Screening Call: 15 min call with HR for alignment on requirements and qualifications.

Deep Dive Interview: 60 min call with Hiring Manager to deep dive on past experiences and profile.

Bar Raiser Interview: 45 min call with another leader to validate assessment with a 2nd opinion.

Cultural Fit Interview: 30 min call with CEO to evaluate culture fit and answer questions about Nova.

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

title: SBS Operations Senior Manager
description:
At Sherwin-Williams, we color the world! With more than 150 years of global excellence, we are a leader in the paints and coatings industry, recognized for innovation, quality, and our commitment to sustainability.

We are seeking an experienced SBS Operations Senior Manager to lead and advance our Shared Business Services operations across Brazil. This role partners closely with SBS Service Delivery teams and business leaders to drive service excellence, operational effectiveness, and strategic growth.

The SBS Operations Senior Manager plays a critical role in overseeing regional service delivery, managing demand pipelines, capacity planning, service placement strategies, and supporting key SBS initiatives across Brazil. This leader will also be responsible for monitoring and improving Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring the organization consistently delivers high-quality, efficient, and scalable services. Beyond operational leadership, this role is empowered to drive transformation through influence, collaboration, communication, and execution. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the successful candidate will champion process standardization, harmonization, optimization, and automation, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, strong governance, and operational excellence.

We are looking for a strategic and influential leader who thrives in complex environments, builds strong partnerships across Finance, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, and is passionate about developing high-performing teams while driving meaningful business impact across Brazil and LATAM.

São Bernardo do Campo, SP, Brazil | Hybrid (3x2)

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage regional processes, business requirements, documentation, playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge repositories. Manage and continuously enhance SBS processes within the service catalog, including the evaluation of current services, regional systems, taxonomies, tools, business process master lists, and repository governance.
  • Lead the execution of the regional transition program, focusing on process standardization, harmonization, streamlining, optimization, and control analysis. Partner closely with SBS Service Delivery teams to identify, design, and implement process improvement initiatives and supporting tools.
  • Prepare and manage the facility budget, process facility-related charges, and monitor expenditures throughout the year to ensure proper financial oversight and cost control.
  • Partner with SBS leadership to build the foundation for the organization and support its continued growth and maturity, driving sustainable operational capabilities and organizational effectiveness.
  • Execute regional transition initiatives to ensure smooth service transfers, effective stakeholder alignment, and seamless handoffs between teams.
  • Develop and implement programs that strengthen operational excellence capabilities, including the assessment, design, and deployment of training initiatives. Promote consistent ways of working, cross-functional collaboration, waste reduction, process standardization, and risk mitigation.
  • Serve as a senior influencer across global, regional, and local leadership teams. Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of standardized SBS processes and operating models. Build strong partnerships across Finance, SBS, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, while effectively communicating vision, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders.
  • Build and develop high-performing teams across LATAM. Drive initiatives that enhance operational excellence capabilities, professional development, and organizational effectiveness. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and learning.

Education

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • MBA, CPA, or other advanced professional certification.

Knowledge & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Finance, Shared Services, Operations, or a related business function, with a proven track record in operational excellence, process management, transformation, and business partnership.
  • Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills. Spanish proficiency is preferred.
  • Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders, build cross-functional relationships, and drive alignment across global, regional, and local teams.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results.
  • Demonstrated success leading teams both directly and through influence in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience within a Shared Services Center (SSC), multinational organization, or business transformation environment is highly desirable.
  • Previous people leadership experience and exposure to transition management, continuous improvement, and change management initiatives are preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of end-to-end business processes, including areas such as Record-to-Report (RTR), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), Hire-to-Retire (HTR), and other Shared Services processes.
  • Understanding of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and performance management frameworks.
  • Experience developing execution strategies, operating procedures, governance models, and process documentation.
  • Knowledge of process improvement methodologies, process standardization, and operational excellence principles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Shared Services technologies, workflow tools, automation solutions, and ERP platforms.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience supporting automation, digital transformation, or process optimization initiatives.

About Us

At Sherwin-Williams, our purpose is to inspire and improve the world by coloring and protecting what matters. Our paints, coatings, and innovative solutions make the places and spaces in our world brighter and stronger. Your skills, talent, and passion make it possible for you to live this purpose while enabling our customers and our company to achieve exceptional results.

Sherwin-Williams recognizes your dedication, growth, and ambition and translates them into opportunities for our team. Our people are the foundation of our success, and we invest in and support you:

In your life... with recognition, benefits, and flexibility to improve your health and well-being.

title: Branch Manager
description:
SPM Oil & Gas is expanding its presence in Brazil and is looking for a Branch Manager to lead the establishment and growth of its local operations. This is a unique opportunity for a commercially driven and entrepreneurial leader who enjoys building businesses, developing customer relationships, and driving operational excellence in a dynamic industry environment.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial leader to establish, develop, and lead SPM's business operations in Brazil while serving as the company's primary representative in the country.

Who We Are:

SPM Oil & Gas, a Caterpillar company, is a leading provider of pressure pumping and flow control solutions serving the global Oil & Gas industry. Our products, services, and expertise support customers throughout critical operations, helping them improve safety, reliability, and performance.

We are currently expanding our operations in Brazil and looking for a pioneering leader to play a key role in establishing and growing our local presence. This is a unique opportunity to join an organization with global reach while helping shape the future of SPM's business in one of the most important energy markets in Latin America.

Position Purpose

Lead the establishment, growth, and overall management of SPM Oil & Gas operations in Brazil, driving business development, operational performance, customer satisfaction, and long-term strategic growth. The Branch Manager will serve as the primary company representative in Brazil and will play a key role in establishing the local operation from the ground up, creating the foundation for future business growth and team expansion across the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategies to establish and grow SPM's business presence in Brazil.

  • Visit customer facilities, ports, vessels, and offshore platforms as required.
  • Support the future development and expansion of the Brazil operation and local team.
  • Assume full accountability for the establishment and performance of SPM's business operations in Brazil.

  • Support regional business activities and customer relationships across Latin America when required.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Management, Finance, or a related field.

Requirements

  • Solid leadership experience within Oil & Gas, Energy, Industrial Services, Manufacturing, or related industries.

  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian market and broader Latin America business environment.

  • Eligibility to obtain the necessary certifications and documentation for offshore and vessel access.
  • Experience building, launching, or significantly expanding business operations is highly desirable.

title: Online Teacher - Whole Child Education | IWS Online School
description:
We are not looking for a teacher. At least, not in the traditional sense.

At IWS Online School, we are hiring teachers across all subjects, and we are looking for people who genuinely care about children and believe education is about much more than delivering a curriculum.

We are looking for someone who notices when a child is quieter than usual. Someone who celebrates the small victories. Someone who understands that confidence, curiosity, character and belonging matter just as much as academic progress.

You may have many years of teaching experience.

You may have relatively little.

That is not the first thing we look at.

We can provide training in curriculum delivery, assessment, pedagogy, online teaching practice, technology and classroom management.

What is much harder to train is:

  • Genuine care for children
  • Empathy and emotional awareness
  • Positive energy and warmth
  • Strong character and responsibility
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn
  • A real desire to make a difference in a child's life

The role

You will teach small groups of students online in your subject area and take responsibility for both their academic progress and their wider development.

This includes:

  • Delivering engaging, high-quality online lessons
  • Teaching your specialist subject effectively
  • Building strong relationships with students
  • Understanding each child as an individual
  • Monitoring progress and providing meaningful feedback
  • Supporting confidence, independence and curiosity
  • Working collaboratively with the wider IWS team
  • Communicating effectively with students, colleagues and families
  • Participating in training and continuous professional development

Who we are looking for

We are recruiting across a wide range of subjects, including core academic subjects, languages, humanities, sciences, technology, creative subjects and other specialist areas.

What matters most is not simply what you teach.

It is how you make children feel while they are learning.

We want teachers who see the child before the lesson.

There is a real young person on the other side of the screen, living one year of their childhood that will never come back.

We take that responsibility seriously.

Our aim is not simply to cover content. We want children to leave IWS stronger, more confident, more curious and better prepared for the world ahead of them.

If that is the kind of education you believe in, we would like to hear from you.

When applying, alongside your CV, tell us about one thing you have done for a child that you are still proud of.

Not your best lesson.

The child.

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
Company Description deepidv is redefining human and AI verification with a proprietary, end-to-end engine and agentic compliance suite built for modern risk, fraud prevention, and continuous monitoring. The platform replaces legacy, API-stitched identity solutions with a single stack that combines Human + AI decisioning, cryptographic proof, and always-on risk and compliance controls. Every verification is triple-encrypted, auditable, and explainable, ensuring that people, documents, and moments of capture are provably real. deepidv operates across 211+ countries without third-party middlemen and is also the team behind UAIIP (Universal AI Identity Protocol) at getai.id, which establishes verifiable identities for AI companions. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and founded by a team with multiple successful exits in fintech and retail.

Role Description The Social Media Content Creator at deepidv is a full-time, remote role responsible for developing and executing content that grows brand awareness and engagement across social platforms. In this role, you will plan and produce short-form and long-form content (posts, threads, videos, carousels), translating complex topics like AI, cryptography, and risk/compliance into accessible, compelling narratives.

You will manage daily posting schedules, community interactions, and real-time engagement, including replies, DMs, and comment moderation. You will collaborate with marketing, product, and leadership to align content with key launches, thought leadership, and go-to-market priorities, while monitoring analytics to refine messaging, formats, and channels. You will also stay current on social trends in AI, security, and fintech to propose new content concepts and experiments that elevate deepidv's voice in the market.

Qualifications

  • Strong social media content creation and storytelling skills, including experience crafting platform-native content for channels such as X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and TikTok.
  • Ability to translate technical or complex topics (AI, identity, security, cryptography, compliance) into clear, engaging, and accurate narratives for varied audiences.
  • Experience with social media strategy, content planning, and editorial calendars, including campaign-based and always-on content.
  • Proficiency with basic design and multimedia tools (e.g., Canva, Figma, or similar), and comfort collaborating with design or video partners.
  • Skill in community management, including handling comments, DMs, and online discussions in a professional, inclusive, and brand-aligned manner.
  • Familiarity with social analytics tools and metrics (engagement, reach, CTR, follower growth) to inform iteration and reporting.
  • Excellent written communication skills in English, with meticulous attention to tone, clarity, and accuracy.

title: Gerente Middle & Corporate Banking
description:
Sobre a Quark

Somos uma assessoria de investimentos credenciada pelo Banco Safra — a solidez de um banco com mais de 180 anos somada à agilidade de uma assessoria. Em poucos anos, passamos de R$1 bilhão sob custódia, com cerca de 70 assessores e mais de 3.000 clientes. Fomos eleitos Revelação Safra em 2024 e estamos entre os três melhores escritórios da rede.

Sobre a área

A área de Middle & Corporate Banking é um dos pilares de crescimento da Quark. Atendemos empresas do Middle Market — faturamento anual entre R$50 e R$400 milhões — e nosso papel vai além de conceder crédito: atuamos como parceiros dos empresários, com soluções sob medida que apoiam o crescimento, a eficiência e a governança dessas companhias.

Buscamos um banker sênior, com forte veia comercial, bagagem sólida em análise de risco de crédito e perfil consultivo. Você vai construir e expandir uma carteira de clientes PJ de médio porte, garantindo rentabilidade, venda cruzada de produtos estruturados e a qualidade de crédito da carteira.

O que você vai fazer

Prospecção e relacionamento

  • Identificar e abordar empresas de médio porte com endividamento saudável e demanda por serviços financeiros, dentro do apetite de risco da Quark.
  • Construir relacionamento próximo com donos, sócios-fundadores e CFOs, entendendo a fundo o negócio e o momento de cada empresa.

Originação e cross-selling

  • Ir além do capital de giro, identificando oportunidades de venda cruzada de produtos de maior valor agregado.
  • Oferecer soluções de tesouraria e cash management: fluxo de caixa, automação de cobranças e pagamentos (Pix/TED), folha de pagamento e derivativos para proteção cambial e de juros (hedge).
  • Originar operações de trade finance (ACC/ACE, cartas de crédito) e estruturados de mercado de capitais (CRI, CRA, debêntures de menor porte), além de mandatos de M&A.

O que buscamos em você

  • Experiência: 3+ anos como banker ou gerente de relacionamento no Middle/Corporate, em bancos de atacado ou plataformas de investimento.
  • Originação: capacidade comprovada de abrir mercado e construir a própria carteira (perfil hunter).
  • Análise de crédito: domínio de leitura de balanços e demonstrações financeiras (DRE, fluxo de caixa) e das dinâmicas de garantias no mundo PJ.
  • Perfil comercial: negociação, resiliência e comunicação clara com decisores.
  • Disponibilidade: atuação presencial em São Paulo, com viagens a praças estratégicas.
  • Desejável: certificação ANCORD

O que oferecemos

  • A prateleira do Banco Safra na sua mão: crédito, tesouraria, trade finance e produtos estruturados de um banco com mais de 180 anos — munição comercial que uma assessoria comum não consegue levar ao cliente.
  • Fixo no quartil superior do mercado financeiro.
  • Bônus atrelado a performance e captação, acima da média.
  • Autonomia para construir e conduzir a sua carteira, com uma mesa sênior de apoio.
  • Caminho de sociedade para quem performa — modelo de partnership.

Se esse desafio faz sentido para o seu momento, candidate-se aqui. Será um prazer conversarmos.

title: Regulatory Affairs Analyst
description:
The Regulatory Affairs Analyst will be responsible for managing regulatory submissions and ensuring compliance with local and international regulatory requirements. This role plays a key part in supporting new product registrations, post-marketing activities, and regulatory strategy execution within the pharmaceutical domain.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review, and submit high-quality CTD dossiers for new drug product registrations and post-marketing variations in compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare and respond to Deficiency Letters issued by ANVISA , ensuring timely and accurate submissions.
  • Conduct risk assessments and gap analyses to enhance regulatory processes and improve dossier quality.
  • Develop and implement regulatory strategies for Pharmaceutical Equivalence Studies and Biowaivers , including coordination of outsourcing activities.
  • Support and monitor the importation process in line with regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Evaluate regulatory feasibility and identify potential risks or requirements to support project execution.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs or Technical Documentation within the pharmaceutical industry .
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, Biomedicine, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of ANVISA regulations , as well as international regulatory guidelines and processes.
  • Proven ability to manage regulatory documentation with accuracy, attention to detail, and compliance focus.
  • Experience in formulations (finished dosgages) is mandatory/compuslory

title: Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência - Ponta Grossa/PR

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então inscreva-se nesta oportunidade!

Esta vaga é exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD) e contempla posições em diversas áreas da unidade de PONTA GROSSA/PR.

Nosso objetivo é identificar e atrair profissionais cujos valores e competências estejam alinhados com a cultura da Arauco. Você será considerado para futuras oportunidades compatíveis com seu perfil.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Analista de Administração de Pessoal Sênior (Folha de Pagamento)
description:
Sobre a AutoZone

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 167 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.

A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além. Fazer parte da empresa significa integrar uma equipe que valoriza dedicação, trabalho em equipe e desenvolvimento profissional, oferecendo suporte e ferramentas para o crescimento e construção de carreira dos AutoZoners.

Descrição do Cargo

Atua como referência técnica da área de Administração de Pessoal, liderando e validando os processos de folha de pagamento, ponto, admissões, rescisões e afastamentos. Gerencia cálculos complexos e análises de impactos financeiros, lidera a interface com jurídico trabalhista e perícias, controla indicadores estratégicos, propõe melhorias contínuas e participa de projetos de compliance e implantação de sistemas.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir a execução e conformidade das rotinas de Administração de Pessoal, observando a legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e as Convenções Coletivas de Trabalho (CCTs).
  • Revisar, validar e orientar cálculos complexos de folha de pagamento, incluindo comissões, PLR, adicionais, encargos e verbas rescisórias.
  • Administrar e controlar processos relacionados ao ponto eletrônico, banco de horas, jornadas de trabalho e parametrizações sistêmicas.
  • Gerenciar afastamentos previdenciários, acompanhando processos de INSS, perícias médicas e retorno ao trabalho.
  • Realizar análises de impactos financeiros decorrentes de negociações sindicais, acordos coletivos e processos de desligamento.
  • Atuar como interface técnica junto ao Jurídico Trabalhista, fornecendo subsídios para processos, auditorias, fiscalizações e contingências.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento das cotas legais de Aprendiz e Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD), propondo ações corretivas quando necessário.
  • Desenvolver, acompanhar e apresentar indicadores gerenciais relacionados a custos de folha, absenteísmo, turnover e passivos trabalhistas.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e padronização dos processos de Administração de Pessoal.
  • Apoiar projetos de implantação, atualização e integração de sistemas de RH e folha de pagamento, garantindo aderência às necessidades do negócio.

Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Psicologia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência em Administração de Pessoal e folha de pagamento.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Legislação Trabalhista e Previdenciária.
  • Experiência com eSocial, encargos trabalhistas e obrigações acessórias.
  • Vivência na interpretação e aplicação de Convenções Coletivas de Trabalho (CCTs).
  • Excel intermediário a avançado.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Diferencial vivência com sistema ADP.

Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios oferecidos: assistência médica, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio com academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e 20% de desconto em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

Venha crescer com a AutoZone e impulsionar o futuro da sua carreira!

title: Sales Manager
description:
Sobre a WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Onde o fornecimento começa

Fundada em 1999, a WIN SOURCE ajuda fabricantes a garantir componentes eletrônicos críticos e a construir cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes em um mercado global cada vez mais complexo, com o apoio de uma equipe global de mais de 450 colaboradores.

Por meio da NEXUSTM, nossa plataforma inteligente para a cadeia de suprimentos, e de nossa rede mundial de recursos de sourcing, estoque e logística, ajudamos os clientes a tomar decisões de aquisição mais inteligentes, fortalecer a continuidade do fornecimento e responder com confiança aos desafios de um mercado em constante evolução.

Atualmente, a WIN SOURCE atende clientes em todo o mundo por meio de operações estrategicamente localizadas na Ásia, Europa e América do Norte, instalações certificadas e um forte compromisso com a qualidade, a confiabilidade e a excelência operacional.

Sobre a função

A função de Gerente de Vendas Internacionais na WIN SOURCE concentra-se na construção de parcerias estratégicas com OEMs globais, empresas de serviços de manufatura eletrônica (EMS) e empresas de tecnologia, ajudando os clientes a solucionar desafios complexos relacionados ao fornecimento de componentes eletrônicos. Ao atuar com clientes dos setores de infraestrutura de IA, automotivo, industrial, médico e de eletrônicos avançados, o profissional contribui para a continuidade da produção e para programas críticos nos quais o fornecimento confiável de componentes é essencial.

Esta posição desempenha um papel importante no apoio aos clientes na aquisição de componentes, gestão de escassez, mitigação de riscos de fim de vida (EOL), otimização de listas de materiais (BOM) e soluções de continuidade do fornecimento. Isso é feito em colaboração com as equipes globais de sourcing, compras e qualidade da WIN SOURCE, contribuindo para cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes que impulsionam a inovação em diversos setores.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes globais e impulsionar o crescimento sustentável dos negócios nos mercados sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Gerenciar toda a jornada de vendas, desde o desenvolvimento de mercado e o relacionamento com clientes até a gestão de solicitações de cotação (RFQs), negociação e fechamento.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com OEMs, empresas de serviços de manufatura eletrônica (EMS) e equipes de engenharia e compras para oferecer soluções confiáveis para o fornecimento de componentes eletrônicos.
  • Ajudar os clientes a enfrentar desafios na cadeia de suprimentos, incluindo escassez, riscos de fim de vida (EOL), transições de ciclo de vida e otimização de custos.
  • Colaborar com equipes globais e representar a WIN SOURCE em reuniões com clientes e eventos do setor.

Por que fazer parte da WIN SOURCE

Na WIN SOURCE, seu trabalho gera valor que vai além das vendas. Você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Conectar-se com empresas globais de tecnologia e ajudar a garantir os componentes críticos que mantêm as indústrias em operação.
  • Atuar em desafios reais da cadeia de suprimentos nos mercados automotivo, industrial, médico e de eletrônicos avançados.
  • Construir relacionamentos estratégicos com profissionais de engenharia, compras e cadeia de suprimentos em todo o mundo.
  • Utilizar a rede global de sourcing e o conhecimento de mercado da WIN SOURCE para oferecer soluções que vão além da distribuição tradicional.
  • Desenvolver sua carreira em uma organização global, na qual seu trabalho contribui para cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes e para as tecnologias do futuro.

O que buscamos

  • Ter 3 anos ou mais de experiência em vendas B2B, gestão de contas, desenvolvimento de negócios ou outras funções comerciais relacionadas, com capacidade comprovada de desenvolver clientes e impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios.
  • Experiência em componentes eletrônicos, semicondutores, distribuição de componentes eletrônicos, EMS ou cadeias de suprimentos da indústria de manufatura é altamente desejável.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e construção de relacionamentos, com capacidade para compreender as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções orientadas à geração de valor.
  • Mentalidade focada no cliente, forte visão comercial e capacidade de gerenciar oportunidades ao longo de todo o ciclo de vendas.
  • Paixão por vendas internacionais e desenvolvimento de negócios, com atitude proativa, forte senso de responsabilidade e motivação para criar valor de longo prazo em um ambiente global.

Benefícios e crescimento profissional

Na WIN SOURCE, reconhecemos e recompensamos as pessoas que geram impacto.

Oferecemos:

  • Salário-base competitivo e estrutura de comissões sem limite, permitindo que profissionais de alto desempenho maximizem seu potencial de ganhos.
  • Oportunidades de vendas globais com clientes internacionais, contas estratégicas e exposição aos mercados mundiais de eletrônicos.
  • A oportunidade de atuar no centro da cadeia global de suprimentos de eletrônicos, ajudando fabricantes a garantir componentes críticos e solucionar desafios reais de negócios.
  • Treinamento profissional, desenvolvimento de conhecimento do setor e um plano de carreira claro rumo à liderança comercial.
  • Oportunidades de participar de mais de 50 feiras internacionais, reuniões com clientes e atividades comerciais globais.
  • Um ambiente multicultural e colaborativo, com equipes na Ásia, Europa e América do Norte.
  • Plano de desenvolvimento de carreira: Gerente de Vendas → Gerente Regional de Vendas → Gerente Regional Sênior de Vendas → Liderança Global de Vendas

title: Comprador - Compras Diretas e Medicamentos - Cuidado Público
description:
Sobre Nós

Com mais de 70 anos de existência, a Einstein Hospital Israelita ainda mantém uma premissa: inovar e crescer, sempre com excelência. Ajudamos a salvar vidas, difundir o conhecimento em educação, prevenção e inovação em saúde. Seguimos oferecendo qualidade, afirmando nosso compromisso com a Responsabilidade Social e com o propósito de levar uma gota de Einstein para cada cidadão. Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão de todos os talentos e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem deste mesmo propósito!

Informações sobre a oportunidade

  • Local de trabalho: Unidades Externas Morumbi (Será dedicado ao Cuidado Público)
  • Jornada de trabalho: 220h - Seg a Quin 08h às 18h / Sex. 08h às 17h
  • Contrato de trabalho: CLT - Prazo indeterminado
  • Área de trabalho: Compras Diretas Medicamentos
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido

Responsabilidades:

  • Contatar fornecedores efetuando cotação de preços, proposta de prazos de entrega e condições de pagamento por telefone, a fim de analisar as melhores condições de compra do produto em questão, apresentando relatório ao superior para decisão;
  • Emitir ordem de fornecimento e ordem de execução para os fornecedores visando suprir a necessidade dos setores do HIAE;
  • Acompanhar as entregas dos pedidos, verificando a falta ou atrasos, checando condições de embalagem dos itens, a fim de relatar todos os passos da compra em questão, montando processos de compra para futuras consultas;
  • Manter cadastro atualizado dos fornecedores, objetivando um contato/pesquisa com agilidade, para que se possa definir com rapidez a aquisição de itens de compra;
  • Acompanhar, via sistema, entrega dos itens sob sua responsabilidade diariamente, verificando tempo dispendido desde o pedido até a chegada do material no HIAE, avaliando e classificando os fornecedores quanto ao prazo e qualidade de entrega, bem como acompanhando evolução de preços dos itens mensalmente;
  • Contatar com o usuário dos itens sob sua responsabilidade, para resolução e/ou coleta de dados necessários para cotação e aquisição de itens, materiais e equipamentos;
  • Posicionar os demais setores da gerência e usuários da previsão de entrega dos itens, possíveis alternativas para falta temporária ou definitiva e grandes variações de preços;
  • Incluir no sistema informatizado o preço de custo dos itens comprados como fora de padrão;
  • Desenvolver marcas alternativas de gêneros alimentícios;
  • Prospectar novos fornecedores e marcas alternativas com foco em resultados e eficiência operacional;
  • Construir indicadores operacionais e financeiros relativos às atividades executadas;
  • Buscar o conhecimento sobre as categorias e itens sob sua responsabilidade de modo a estar capacitado a prospectar o mercado em busca de oportunidades suportado por conhecimento técnico assistencial;
  • Buscar drivers de negociação, conhecimento em metodologias de suprimentos, TCO, Cost Break Down, Strategic Sourcing, Modelos de leilão;
  • Analisar de forma holística e integrada categorias e mercado fornecedor em busca de oportunidades;
  • Buscar constantemente o conhecimento e atualização do mercado nacional e global, com visão integrada de movimentos de mercado e capacidade analítica de impactos.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo;
  • Experiência na área de atuação;
  • Experiência em negociação com fornecedores;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas informatizados;
  • Noções de planejamento de estoque;
  • Experiência com Excel e Power BI;

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Análise Curricular;
  • Entrevista R&S;
  • Entrevista Gestor;
  • Ressaltamos que todas as etapas são de caráter eliminatório.

Einstein Benefícios - Compartilhando Bem-Estar

  • Cuidados com a saúde: Convênio Médico e Assistência Odontológica.
  • Bem-estar: Totalpass e Programa de Orientação Pessoal.
  • Para você e sua família: Seguro de Vida, Auxílio Creche para mães ou pais com guarda legal.
  • Alimentação: Refeitório no local de trabalho e Vale Alimentação.
  • Mobilidade: Vale Transporte, Estacionamento (Conforme Política Institucional de Liberação).

**Os benefícios podem sofrer alteração de acordo com a convenção coletiva,unidade de trabalho e políticas vigentes.

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia focada em desenvolvimento de software, inovação e soluções digitais.   • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho e identificar oportunidades de melhoria;

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência com gestão de redes sociais;
  • Excelente comunicação escrita;
  • Boa capacidade de criação de conteúdo e storytelling;
  • Familiaridade com Instagram, LinkedIn, Reels e formatos de vídeos curtos;

  • Facilidade para interagir com diferentes pessoas e conduzir gravações com colaboradores e lideranças.

Será um diferencial

  • Experiência com empresas de tecnologia ou mercado B2B;
  • Conhecimento em tráfego pago e Meta Ads;
  • Experiência com produção de Reels e vídeos de alta retenção;
  • Conhecimento de métricas e ferramentas de análise de redes sociais;
  • Noções de branding e posicionamento de marca;
  • Experiência com cobertura de eventos;
  • Portfólio de conteúdos ou perfis que já tenha administrado.

Perfil que buscamos

Mais do que alguém para simplesmente publicar posts, buscamos uma pessoa que tenha visão de conteúdo.

Alguém que esteja presente no dia a dia da empresa e consiga perceber:

"Isso pode virar um conteúdo."

"Essa história precisa ser contada."

"Esse projeto demonstra a capacidade da empresa."

"Esse momento pode aproximar nossa marca das pessoas."

Queremos construir uma presença digital forte, profissional e humana, mostrando não apenas o que a Table IT faz, mas também as pessoas, projetos, desafios e histórias por trás da tecnologia.

Se você gosta de criar, contar histórias e transformar o cotidiano de uma empresa em conteúdo que gera conexão e autoridade, queremos conhecer você.

description:

Somos da Masterboi, uma empresa genuinamente Pernambucana dedicada a alimentar vidas, com matriz em Recife – PE, há mais 25 anos construindo história no mercado nacional e internacional de processamento e distribuição de alimentos, tornando-se referência no segmento.

Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de:

Coordenador de Manutenção de Frota (CLT / Presencial)

  • Coordenar toda a equipe de manutenção automotiva, almoxarifado, compras, lava-jato, bombista e pneu;
  • Acompanhar ausência (atestados/faltas) e presença da equipe;

TotalPass;

Vaga 100% presencial.

title: Gerente de contas
description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre nós:

A Penso Tecnologia é uma empresa de serviços de TI criada para possibilitar que os clientes utilizem a tecnologia a favor de seus negócios. Estamos alinhados a tecnologias globais para expandir o negócio de nossos clientes. Em nosso portifólio contamos com soluções de atuação on-premises e soluções de cloud computing.

Atuar na prospecção, desenvolvimento e fechamento de oportunidades comerciais no mercado governamental, junto a órgãos públicos, empresas estatais e demais organizações da Administração Pública.

  • Manter pipeline, forecast e CRM atualizados;
  • Atuar na renovação, expansão e desenvolvimento da carteira de clientes;

  • Capacidade de interpretar editais e requisitos de contratação;
  • Experiência com prospecção, negociação e fechamento de negócios;
  • Conhecimento de soluções de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Boa comunicação, organização, negociação e foco em resultados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Carteira de relacionamento com órgãos públicos;
  • Vivência com soluções de Cloud, infraestrutura, segurança, backup, SaaS ou serviços gerenciados;
  • Cursos ou certificações relacionados a licitações ou vendas consultivas

title: Sales Manager
description:
About WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins

Founded in 1999, WIN SOURCE helps manufacturers secure critical electronic components and build more resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex global market,supported by a global team of 450+ employees.

Through NEXUSTM, our intelligent supply chain platform, and our worldwide network of sourcing, inventory and logistics capabilities, we help customers make smarter sourcing decisions, strengthen supply continuity and respond confidently to evolving market challenges.

Today, WIN SOURCE serves customers worldwide through strategically located operations across Asia, Europe and North America, certified facilities and a strong commitment to quality, reliability and operational excellence.

About the Role

The International Sales Manager role at WIN SOURCE focuses on building strategic partnerships with global OEMs, EMS providers and technology companies while helping customers solve complex electronic component supply challenges. Working with customers across AI infrastructure, automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics sectors, this role helps customers maintain production continuity and support critical programs where reliable component supply is essential.

This position plays an important role in supporting customers with component sourcing, shortage management, EOL risk mitigation, BOM optimization and supply continuity solutions through collaboration with WIN SOURCE's global sourcing, procurement and quality teams, and build more resilient supply chains that support innovation across industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop strategic relationships with global customers and drive sustainable business growth across assigned markets.
  • Manage the complete sales journey, from market development and customer engagement to RFQ management, negotiation and closing.
  • Partner with OEMs, EMS providers, engineering and procurement teams to deliver reliable electronic component sourcing solutions.
  • Help customers navigate supply chain challenges, including shortages, EOL risks, lifecycle transitions and cost optimization.
  • Collaborate with global teams and represent WIN SOURCE at customer meetings and industry events.

Why Join WIN SOURCE

At WIN SOURCE, your work creates value beyond sales. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Connect with global technology companies and help secure the critical components that keep industries moving.
  • Work on real supply chain challenges across automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics markets.
  • Build strategic relationships with global engineering, procurement and supply chain professionals.
  • Leverage WIN SOURCE's global sourcing network and market expertise to deliver solutions beyond traditional distribution.
  • Grow your career in a global organization where your work contributes to more resilient supply chains and future technologies.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, business development or related commercial roles, with a proven ability to develop customers and drive business growth.
  • Experience in electronic components, semiconductors, electronics distribution, EMS or manufacturing supply chains is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and deliver value-driven solutions.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness and the ability to manage opportunities throughout the sales cycle.
  • Passion for international sales and business development, with a proactive mindset, strong ownership and the drive to create long-term value in a global environment.

Benefits & Career Growth

At WIN SOURCE, we recognize and reward people who create impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped commission structure, giving high performers the opportunity to maximize their earning potential.
  • Global sales opportunities with international customers, strategic accounts and exposure to worldwide electronics markets.
  • The opportunity to work at the center of the global electronics supply chain, helping manufacturers secure critical components and solve real business challenges.
  • Professional training, industry knowledge development and a clear career path toward commercial leadership.
  • Opportunities to participate in 50+ international exhibitions, customer meetings and global business activities.
  • A multicultural and collaborative environment with teams across Asia, Europe and North America.
  • Career development path: Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → Senior Regional Sales Manager → Global Sales Leadership

Join WIN SOURCE

Ready to grow your international sales career and make an impact in the global electronics supply chain?

Apply today and join WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins.

Submit your application through LinkedIn or send your resume to:

Follow WIN SOURCE on LinkedIn for the latest company updates, industry insights and career opportunities.

title: Advogado júnior
description:
A Neohype faz parte de um grupo focado em acelerar a transformação digital no Brasil. Ao nosso lado, você atua com autonomia, impacto real e visibilidade direta na construção da nossa jornada de crescimento. Quer construir o futuro do trabalho com a gente?

Buscamos uma Pessoa para ser Advogado(a) Júnior com foco no Preventivo Trabalhista para atuar no suporte consultivo, análise de riscos e orientação jurídica estratégica, garantindo a conformidade legal e a melhoria contínua dos processos internos de RH e Negócios.

Essa Pessoa terá uma atuação abrangente, desde a análise consultiva de rotinas trabalhistas até a elaboração de pareceres, apoio na gestão de passivos e atuação técnica alinhada às diretrizes corporativas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar diretamente no consultivo e preventivo trabalhista, identificando riscos e orientando as áreas de negócio e RH.
  • Prestar suporte técnico e operacional em rotinas jurídicas trabalhistas, sanando dúvidas e garantindo o cumprimento da legislação vigente.
  • Investigar e analisar divergências trabalhistas, acordos, convenções coletivas e práticas corporativas.
  • Elaborar pareceres jurídicos, políticas internas, notificações, respostas administrativas e revisão de contratos sob a ótica trabalhista.
  • Implementar e acompanhar indicadores de conformidade trabalhista, sugerindo melhorias preventivas para redução de passivos.
  • Desenvolver e atualizar relatórios, mapeamentos de riscos e documentações técnicas da área jurídica.
  • Criar e conduzir alinhamentos, orientações e treinamentos sobre boas práticas e legislação trabalhista para os gestores.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Superior completa em Direito com inscrição ativa na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB).
  • Experiência prévia (estágio ou atuação como advogado) focada em Direito do Trabalho, com vivência em preventivo/consultivo.
  • Conhecimento sólido da Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho (CLT), legislação complementar e rotinas de RH/DP.
  • Capacidade demonstrada de análise crítica, investigação e resolução de dúvidas e conflitos jurídicos de forma preventiva.
  • Perfil hands-on, autônomo, com excelente comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com áreas operacionais e executivas.
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de gerenciar prazos e demandas simultâneas.

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em ambiente corporativo, consultoria jurídica ou escritórios de advocacia com foco em clientes corporativos.
  • Conhecimento em rotinas de eSocial, auditoria trabalhista e governança trabalhista.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais, sistemas de gestão jurídica e Excel intermediário/avançado.

title: Project Manager
description:
The project is part of a next-generation SaaS technology platform operating in the transportation and supply chain logistics domain. The company behind the platform has decades of industry experience and is recognized as an employer of choice, with a strong culture of innovation and technical excellence.

The platform delivers a suite of data-driven software solutions used daily by millions of customers who rely on accurate, real-time insights to make informed business decisions and improve profitability. At its core, the system supports one of the largest digital marketplaces in its industry, processing hundreds of millions of transactions annually and maintaining a massive database representing hundreds of billions of dollars in global market activity.

The technology stack is built to handle extreme scale, high availability, and data accuracy, enabling customers to operate efficiently in a fast-moving, competitive environment. Engineering teams work on highly distributed systems, advanced data processing pipelines, and analytics-driven services that continuously evolve to meet growing market demands.

Responsibilities

Team Management & People Development

  • Manage and support the engineering team ±20 people in LATAM (incl. but not only Brazil) through regular 1:1 meetings.
  • Build strong relationships with team members and maintain a healthy and productive team environment.
  • Support engineers in their professional development and career growth.
  • Monitor individual and team performance and provide regular feedback.
  • Identify performance issues early and create improvement plans when necessary.
  • Support employee engagement, motivation, and retention.
  • Handle and help resolve conflicts within the team.

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Manage the onboarding of new team members and ensure smooth integration into the company and client teams.
  • Support engineers during their first months on the project and monitor their adaptation and performance.
  • Manage the offboarding process and coordinate communication with internal teams and client stakeholders when required.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Manage the recruitment process for new engineers in cooperation with the Recruitment team.
  • Clarify position requirements, seniority, technical expectations, and team needs.
  • Participate in candidate evaluation and final hiring decisions.
  • Monitor staffing progress and proactively address hiring challenges.
  • Support workforce planning and identify future staffing needs.

Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders.
  • Understand client expectations, priorities, concerns, and business needs.
  • Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and provide visibility into team performance, staffing, risks, and delivery-related topics.
  • Manage client expectations and proactively address potential issues.
  • Handle difficult conversations and conflicts between the client, engineers, and the company.
  • Represent the company's interests while maintaining a strong and trusted relationship with the client.
  • Escalate risks and critical issues appropriately and work with both sides toward mutually acceptable solutions.

Business Development & Account Growth

  • Understand the client's organization, business objectives, and future plans.
  • Identify opportunities to expand cooperation with existing clients.
  • Recognize potential needs for additional engineers, teams, or services and communicate opportunities internally.
  • Participate in discussions related to new roles, team extensions, and new areas of cooperation.
  • Build relationships with additional stakeholders within the client organization.
  • Support account growth by maintaining high client satisfaction and identifying opportunities for further partnership.
  • Work closely with Delivery, Sales, Recruitment, and other internal teams on account development.

Operational Management

  • Monitor team allocation, staffing changes, performance risks, and retention risks.
  • Coordinate internal processes related to employees working on client accounts.
  • Ensure important information is communicated between the client, engineers, and internal company stakeholders.
  • Identify operational risks and proactively propose solutions.
  • Support planning related to team structure, replacements, transfers, and future growth.

Skills & Experience Required

Management Experience

  • Experience managing software engineering teams.
  • Strong people-management and coaching skills.
  • Experience conducting 1:1s, performance reviews, development discussions, and difficult conversations.
  • Ability to identify performance and motivation issues and take appropriate action.
  • Strong conflict-management and problem-solving skills.

Outsourcing / IT Services Experience

  • Previous experience working in an IT outsourcing, consulting, nearshore, or software services company is highly preferred.
  • Understanding of the relationship between the client, outsourcing company, and engineers assigned to the client project.
  • Experience balancing client expectations with company and employee interests.
  • Understanding of common outsourcing challenges, including staffing, retention, performance management, replacements, rate discussions, and client satisfaction.
  • Ability to act as a trusted intermediary when disagreements or conflicts arise between the client and the company.

Stakeholder Management

  • Strong stakeholder-management and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with international clients and distributed teams.
  • Ability to manage expectations, negotiate priorities, and handle sensitive situations professionally.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills.

Business Development

  • Commercial mindset and interest in developing existing client accounts.
  • Ability to recognize new business and team-growth opportunities.
  • Ability to understand client business needs beyond the immediate engineering scope.
  • Experience participating in account-growth, staffing, or client-development discussions is preferred.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships that can lead to long-term cooperation and account expansion.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Understanding of the software engineering recruitment process.
  • Ability to define hiring needs together with technical and client stakeholders.
  • Experience interviewing or evaluating candidates is preferred.
  • Understanding of the Brazilian engineering talent market is an advantage.

Communication & Personal Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong ownership and proactive mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to manage several people-related, client-related, and operational topics simultaneously.
  • High emotional intelligence and ability to work effectively in challenging or sensitive situations.
  • Ability to communicate bad news, risks, or disagreements clearly and constructively.

Language & International Environment

  • Strong professional English is required for communication with international clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience working in multicultural and distributed environments is preferred.

title: Advogado Sr ( Contencioso)
description:
Venha fazer parte da equipe Jurídica do maior aeroporto da América Latina!

title: Analista de Suporte ao Cliente Júnior
description:
Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para fazer parte do time de Suporte do Risposta, atuando como primeiro ponto de contato dos nossos clientes com a empresa.

Procuramos alguém com boa comunicação, organização, curiosidade e vontade de aprender. Não esperamos que você já conheça todas as respostas. Buscamos uma pessoa que saiba investigar problemas, seguir processos, buscar informações e se comunicar de forma clara e acolhedora com o cliente.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar o atendimento de primeiro nível, N1, aos clientes pelos canais oficiais da empresa;
  • Identificar dúvidas, dificuldades e problemas relatados pelos clientes;
  • Realizar diagnósticos e seguir os procedimentos definidos para resolução de problemas;
  • Solucionar chamados de baixa complexidade dentro da autonomia do N1;
  • Orientar clientes sobre utilização, configurações e funcionalidades da plataforma;
  • Registrar os chamados e as informações relevantes de cada atendimento;
  • Solicitar evidências, como prints, fotos e vídeos, quando necessárias para o diagnóstico;
  • Acompanhar as solicitações até sua resolução ou direcionamento para outra área;
  • Escalonar para o N2 ou para o time de Tecnologia casos que necessitem de uma análise técnica mais aprofundada;
  • Garantir que chamados escalados contenham todas as informações e evidências necessárias para continuidade da análise;
  • Atuar de acordo com os SLAs, processos e padrões de qualidade do time de Suporte;
  • Consultar e contribuir para a atualização da base de conhecimento e das documentações internas;
  • Identificar problemas recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria na experiência dos clientes.

O que buscamos

  • Graduação concluída ou em andamento em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas é bem-vinda, mas não é obrigatória para a posição.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e boa comunicação verbal;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Facilidade para aprender e utilizar novas ferramentas;
  • Raciocínio lógico e perfil investigativo;
  • Capacidade de seguir processos e procedimentos;
  • Proatividade e disposição para aprender;
  • Cordialidade e equilíbrio para lidar com diferentes situações e perfis de clientes;
  • Capacidade de identificar prioridades e organizar as demandas do dia a dia.

Será um diferencial

  • Experiência anterior com atendimento ao cliente ou suporte;
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou SaaS;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de atendimento e gestão de chamados;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre dispositivos Android, conexão com a internet e redes Wi-Fi;
  • Experiência com atendimento por WhatsApp, chat ou e-mail.

O que valorizamos

No Risposta, buscamos pessoas que tenham responsabilidade com o cliente e interesse genuíno em entender um problema antes de buscar sua solução.

Para essa posição, queremos alguém que não se limite a responder chamados, mas que tenha curiosidade para investigar, aprender com cada atendimento e contribuir para uma experiência de suporte cada vez melhor.

Se você gosta de ajudar pessoas, investigar problemas e quer se desenvolver trabalhando com tecnologia, queremos conhecer você.

title: Senior HR Analyst - Systems
description:
About Us

At Lightera, we empower our employees to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful impact on the world. We foster a supportive, dynamic, and inclusive workplace where people can thrive, collaborate, and drive positive change.

If you are looking for a rewarding career with opportunities to learn, lead, and contribute to cutting-edge innovation, this opportunity could be for you!

We are looking for a Senior HR Analyst, with a strong focus on HR Systems and Processes. This role will be responsible for supporting the implementation, maintenance, optimization, integration, and transformation of HR systems, representing the needs and requirements of the LATAM region in global initiatives and ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines and solutions.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Knowledge of systems integration, HR data management, reporting, and People Analytics.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll processes and systems, HR operations, HCM platforms, and employee lifecycle processes.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian labor legislation and regulatory requirements; knowledge of other LATAM countries is a plus.
  • Proven experience supporting and/or leading HR technology implementation and transformation projects.
  • Experience working in multinational organizations, across regions and with cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of process mapping, continuous improvement, and project management.

Responsibilities:

HR Systems & Technology

  • Represent the LATAM region in global HR technology discussions, projects, and forums.
  • Act as the regional point of contact for HR systems and HR operational processes.
  • Support the evaluation, configuration, testing, implementation, and optimization of HR technology platforms.
  • Ensure that business requirements from the LATAM region are properly identified and incorporated into global solutions.
  • Coordinate, together with the IT team, system updates, integrations, enhancements, and regional implementations.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and improve HR processes through technology.
  • Monitor trends in HR technology, including AI and automation, and recommend opportunities for improvement.

Legacy Systems Management

  • Support the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of existing HR systems.
  • Coordinate issue resolution, process improvements, and user support activities.
  • Support data migration, testing, validation, and system transition activities.
  • Ensure business continuity throughout migrations and transformation initiatives.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation of systems, processes, and configurations.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy and security requirements, including Brazil's LGPD.

Project & Transformation Management

  • Participate in and coordinate regional HR technology and process transformation projects.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, stakeholder communications, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Coordinate collaboration among HR, IT, Finance, payroll providers, external partners, and business stakeholders.
  • Support change management activities, including training, communication, and user adoption.
  • Track project progress and support successful implementation and adoption.

Payroll & HR Operations

  • Partner with Payroll and HR Operations teams to improve process effectiveness, controls, and compliance.
  • Support payroll-related systems, integrations, reporting, and controls.
  • Support the development and standardization of regional HR procedures and controls.
  • Monitor changes in labor legislation and regulatory requirements across LATAM countries.
  • Assess and support the implementation of required changes to HR systems, processes, and controls.

title: Data Annotator - Brazil
description:
Brazil (pt-BR)

Job Title: Data Annotator, Fluent Bilingual Portuguese & English (Brazil-Based)

Location: Remote (Brazil residents only, not open internationally)

Pay: $4.00 per hour (approx. 10 to 15 hrs/week, up to a maximum of 30 hrs/week depending on availability)

Essential requirements (please only apply if you meet all of these):

  • You must be currently physically located in Brazil. This will be verified, and applications from candidates located elsewhere cannot be progressed.
  • You must be fluent in both English and Portuguese. This role requires strong command of both languages, not just one.
  • You must be eligible to work as a self-employed/freelance contractor (sole trader or via your own Personal Service Company). This will be verified.

Morpheus are partnered with a global data solutions provider working on a project for one of the world's largest social media platforms. They're looking for detail-oriented, freelance annotators based in Brazil to build a global network of independent contractors supporting this project on a flexible, work-from-home basis.

About the role: You'll analyse user search queries, label data, review social media posts and content, and answer questions based on your reasoning and the project guidelines provided. Because the content is specific to Brazil's local geography and culture, being based in Brazil and having strong dual fluency in Portuguese and English are both essential to the work itself, not just a nice-to-have.

Project details:

  • Duration: approximately 1 to 2 months depending on project status, with potential for ongoing work or transition to other projects based on performance.
  • Expected start date: ASAP. We're onboarding quickly for this project, so please only apply if you can start within the next few days and are able to respond promptly throughout the process.
  • Most contributors find that meeting project output needs takes around 10 to 15 hours per week, with flexibility to take on up to a maximum of 30 hours per week depending on project need and your availability.
  • Complete freedom to complete those hours at any time of day or night.

What you'll need:

  • Your own laptop or desktop computer (preferred over other devices)
  • Consistent, reliable internet access
  • Strong attention to detail and reasoning skills
  • Comfort working independently in a remote setting

Please note: while not expected, you may occasionally be exposed to sensitive content as part of this role.

As part of the application process, you'll complete a short assessment. This must be completed independently and without AI assistance; submissions are checked for this.

If you're based in Brazil, fluent in both English and Portuguese, and this sounds like the flexible, remote opportunity you've been looking for, apply now to find out more.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins

Founded in 1999, WIN SOURCE helps manufacturers secure critical electronic components and build more resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex global market,supported by a global team of 450+ employees.

Through NEXUSTM, our intelligent supply chain platform, and our worldwide network of sourcing, inventory and logistics capabilities, we help customers make smarter sourcing decisions, strengthen supply continuity and respond confidently to evolving market challenges.

Today, WIN SOURCE serves customers worldwide through strategically located operations across Asia, Europe and North America, certified facilities and a strong commitment to quality, reliability and operational excellence.

About the Role

The International Sales Manager role at WIN SOURCE focuses on building strategic partnerships with global OEMs, EMS providers and technology companies while helping customers solve complex electronic component supply challenges. Working with customers across AI infrastructure, automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics sectors, this role helps customers maintain production continuity and support critical programs where reliable component supply is essential.

This position plays an important role in supporting customers with component sourcing, shortage management, EOL risk mitigation, BOM optimization and supply continuity solutions through collaboration with WIN SOURCE's global sourcing, procurement and quality teams, and build more resilient supply chains that support innovation across industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop strategic relationships with global customers and drive sustainable business growth across assigned markets.
  • Manage the complete sales journey, from market development and customer engagement to RFQ management, negotiation and closing.
  • Partner with OEMs, EMS providers, engineering and procurement teams to deliver reliable electronic component sourcing solutions.
  • Help customers navigate supply chain challenges, including shortages, EOL risks, lifecycle transitions and cost optimization.
  • Collaborate with global teams and represent WIN SOURCE at customer meetings and industry events.

Why Join WIN SOURCE

At WIN SOURCE, your work creates value beyond sales. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Connect with global technology companies and help secure the critical components that keep industries moving.
  • Work on real supply chain challenges across automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics markets.
  • Build strategic relationships with global engineering, procurement and supply chain professionals.
  • Leverage WIN SOURCE's global sourcing network and market expertise to deliver solutions beyond traditional distribution.
  • Grow your career in a global organization where your work contributes to more resilient supply chains and future technologies.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, business development or related commercial roles, with a proven ability to develop customers and drive business growth.
  • Experience in electronic components, semiconductors, electronics distribution, EMS or manufacturing supply chains is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and deliver value-driven solutions.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness and the ability to manage opportunities throughout the sales cycle.
  • Passion for international sales and business development, with a proactive mindset, strong ownership and the drive to create long-term value in a global environment.

Benefits & Career Growth

At WIN SOURCE, we recognize and reward people who create impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped commission structure, giving high performers the opportunity to maximize their earning potential.
  • Global sales opportunities with international customers, strategic accounts and exposure to worldwide electronics markets.
  • The opportunity to work at the center of the global electronics supply chain, helping manufacturers secure critical components and solve real business challenges.
  • Professional training, industry knowledge development and a clear career path toward commercial leadership.
  • Opportunities to participate in 50+ international exhibitions, customer meetings and global business activities.
  • A multicultural and collaborative environment with teams across Asia, Europe and North America.
  • Career development path: Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → Senior Regional Sales Manager → Global Sales Leadership

Join WIN SOURCE

Ready to grow your international sales career and make an impact in the global electronics supply chain?

Apply today and join WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins.

Submit your application through LinkedIn or send your resume to:

Follow WIN SOURCE on LinkedIn for the latest company updates, industry insights and career opportunities.
